personal.description: I'm Claudinei Alves, a developer focused on Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, and software development. I'm passionate about building intelligent systems and data-driven applications, using primarily Python, machine learning, and modern web development technologies. I'm currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence, where I develop projects involving data analysis, machine learning models, and technological solutions for real-world problems. I constantly seek to learn new technologies and apply knowledge in practical and innovative projects.
